notes.title: I have deleted the ability to save (entirely!) from the game (for now).
notes.notes:
Don't worry, the game is only around 40-70 minutes in total depending on your play style. 

I know that sounds long, so you should find a relatively free evening to play this game. 

If you die, you will be teleported to an earlier part of your current level with restored health. You can then make your way back to the enemies (which have been weakened so the gameplay is less frustration).

[b]Why did I do this?
[/b]
Unfortunately, this game has a terrible issue where the game crashes after you load a save file (but only if you shut down the game first). If you load from a save file but you don't shut down the game, it will work properly (for the most part).

I haven't been able to find out what is causing this issue. It seems to be a coding issue, but I'm not sure how to bypass it. I've checked all collision issues and texture sizes, but everything seems to be fine.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44502488/cfb2509a4ba1942a7a9ebcceeb5e7596f91d92b6.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Duplicated events for doors for ease of use
notes.notes: I've duplicated door events and placed the second duplicate behind the door so people can use and interact with doors even when they are very close. Before, when accessing some of the doors, you sometimes had to step back before you get any interaction (i.e., the door opens or you get a notification about how it's locked).

notes.title: Fixed lack of start
notes.notes: I was in such a hurry to create the last update (fixing the three bugs) that I forgot to reset the start of the game. I've just fixed it now so the player can actually play the game from the beginning.

notes.title: Fixed more bugs
notes.notes:
Fixed 3 bugs (courtesy of R.N. Roveleh for spotting these):

1) Before, when you were defeated by the ghost in the repeating corridor, the dark overlay would still be on the screen when you respawn in the speakeasy. This has been removed.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44502488/54f8d61cbfad155b66643699492d02c2e4ea6ef4.jpg[/img]

2) Camera goes out of bound when you try to fetch the blue potion on the left side of the screen in the Classical Department Museum level. I moved the blue potion closer to the middle of the room to avoid this issue.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44502488/69471b695bb27e175e7a610b0228a98eba7607f1.jpg[/img]

3) After defeating the NPC Tamara, the game crashes due to "Object ID 36" not being found. It turned out that Object ID 36 referred to the copy of the player character I pasted into that level for playtesting. I didn't debug that level so there were still references to that Object ID even though I had deleted that copy.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44502488/dfe309e456bbc927c7934a651cce975073f898bf.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Fixed level problem before the fight with Sam
notes.notes: I forgot to remove a testing feature where I added 7 levels to the player before the player with Sam. I did that because I moved the player start to the theatre to test out some new features, and I wanted to defeat Sam to progress to the next level, so I had to add the levels to do that.
